assumptions: alpha1 > 1, alpha2 > 1 - b/m, alpha_i > 0 for i=3,4,5
theorems.conclusion: All closed-loop states bounded; y and dot y track y_d and dot y_d in finite time.
theorems.time_property: claimed finite time; proof gives negative quadratic Lyapunov derivative
theorems.audit: The displayed V2/V5 inequalities are exponential (dot V <= -c V), not finite-time (dot V <= -c V^rho, rho<1). The finite-time label is not supported for the tracking error.

theorems.conclusion: Observer errors eps_i (i=2,3,5) are globally FTUB; |s_i| <= alpha_i^{-1}(sigma_i) after finite time t_i.
theorems.time_property: FTUB; t_i depends on s_i(0), alpha_i(.), sigma_i
theorems.audit: Proof is not closed: the actual error dynamics contain -(b/m)eps2, -(2 rho A_p/V0)eps2 and -2 ee we eps5, absent from (19)-(21). (19)-(20) also contain typographical extra s_i factors. The finite-time observer claim is plausible but not established by the printed proof.

assumptions: Theta2 >> alpha2^{-1}(sigma2), Theta3 >> alpha3^{-1}(sigma3), Theta5 >> alpha5^{-1}(sigma5), where >> is stated to mean much greater than
theorems.conclusion: Closed loop (2),(16),(17),(22) is bounded; y and dot y track y_d and dot y_d in finite time.
theorems.time_property: claimed finite time; V5 inequality is exponential after observer convergence
theorems.audit: The V5 step can be closed under Delta_i >= 0 and Theta_i > |Delta_tilde_i|; for Delta_i < 0 the margin must be Theta_i > 2|Delta_i| + |Delta_tilde_i|, which is not stated. The pre-convergence interval t < T_i is not separately proven. Input boundedness is not a theorem conclusion.

priority_question_answers.time_transformation_clock: absolute time t since t=0; mu(t)=(e^t+1)/2; no terminal time T anywhere in the paper
priority_question_answers.tracking_error_actual_property: exponential asymptotic convergence of transformed errors; |eps1| <= sqrt(2 V5(0)) exp(-c5 t)/mu(t); no finite-time (fractional-power) inequality
priority_question_answers.observer_finite_time_claim: stated as FTUB with explicit t_i, but proof has unclosed linear/coupling terms
priority_question_answers.closed_loop_state_boundedness_proven: conditional, under unknown sigma_i-dependent Theta_i conditions

open_items: O1: Eq.(8) prefactor may lack 1/mu; independent derivation requires m/(A_p mu).
O2: Theorem 1 t_i form and whether alpha_i is constant or class-K are not resolved.
O3: Eq.(31) subscripts 3 vs 5 in the final V5 case analysis.
O4: dot Delta_hat_i contains eps^{q/p-1}, singular at eps=0.
O5: Residual bound requires Delta_i >= 0 or a factor-2 larger Theta_i.
O6: Required reference derivative order (at least y_d^(4)) is not stated.
O7: Theta_i >> alpha_i^{-1}(sigma_i) depends on unknown sigma_i; >> is not a strict inequality.
O8: Pre-observer-convergence interval t < T_i boundedness is not separately proven.
O9: Input boundedness and saturation are outside the theorem.
O10: Capped mu has a derivative jump at delta_t; u may jump through dot Phi terms.
O11: x3 is measured yet x3hat is estimated.
O13: Table 1 omits b and k_e.
O14: J_e is described as infinity-norm based but defined as an integral.
